mostWorthwhile.text: Making and exporting collagen was the most worthwhile passage: it connected a repair cell’s protein-making work to support for the tissue around it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to put edge cells directly on the scrape was briefly confusing because the need for signals was not clear to me beforehand. The compatibility feedback resolved it.

surprise.text: Closing the surface did not restore the deeper tissue’s strength; the comparison under tension made that distinction clear.

arbitrary.text: I initially missed why local signals had to act on the edge cells first, but the result showed them prompting cells to divide and move.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter connected cellular work to a different body-level problem. The repair sequence made those relationships understandable, although the combinations became fairly predictable.
